ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Check the department; it is filled in when the inject names one.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Write a few sentences, and press Log note.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Prefer to speak? Tap the microphone, speak, and tap it again.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Correct the words, then press Log note; speaking alone never sends anything.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Note what the team did, and what the plan says.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Where there is no plan, note what the inject asked for.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Never name a person.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">If something would stop the response altogether, choose Critical gap.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Your note reaches the facilitator straight away.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">To reach the facilitator, open Messages, tap a ready-made line such as Our room needs more time, and press Send.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Or type your own message and press Send.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">It goes for your room, not under your name.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Replies stay at the top until you press Got it or Reply.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Took a call, or locked your screen?</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Nothing is lost. The page catches up by itself.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">If your device restarts, open the same link and press Continue on Welcome back.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Logged notes are saved, and an unfinished note comes back on the same device.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">If a participant loses their page, tap Show join code.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Your screen fills with the code for them to scan.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">After the end, your notes stay open for up to five hours.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Then please answer the one-minute survey.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">To recap. Watch, never guide, and log notes with Log note.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Critical gap reaches the facilitator at once.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Show join code helps anyone who loses their page.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Please set your phone or laptop to silent now. Thank you.</prosody></voice></speak>
